public_definitions: The task requires reviewing the cereal comparison dashboard for the '11-18 years' age group.
The decision must be based on the displayed comparison to determine if the category should be escalated for 'adolescent fibre-support follow-up' or sent for 'general nutrition reference review'.

The three options are: 'Route high-fibre breakfast cereals for 11-18 years to adolescent fibre-support follow-up', 'Route other breakfast cereals for 11-18 years to adolescent fibre-support follow-up', or 'Route the 11-18 years cereal comparison to general nutrition reference review'.
